expr: ((List.range intervals.length).map (fun (i : Nat) => let remaining := List.eraseIdx intervals i; let sorted := List.mergeSort remaining (fun (a b : Nat × Nat) => a.1 ≤ b.1); let merged := sorted.foldl (fun acc curr => match acc with | [] => [curr] | (s, e) :: rest => if curr.1 ≤ e then (s, max e curr.2) :: rest else curr :: acc) []; merged.reverse.foldl (fun acc (s, e) => acc + (e - s)) 0)).foldl max 0

lemmas.name: argmax_spec
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Nat) (f : Nat → Nat), 0 < n → ∃ i, i < n ∧ f i = ((List.range n).map f).foldl max 0 ∧ ∀ j, j < n → f j ≤ ((List.range n).map f).foldl max 0
lemmas.proof:
by intro n f hn
  have hne : (List.range n).map f ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_mem (a := f 0) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨0, List.mem_range.mpr hn, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Refine.maxlist_nat _ hne
  rw [List.contains_iff_mem, List.mem_map] at h1
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hfi⟩ := h1
  refine ⟨i, List.mem_range.mp hi, hfi, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have := List.all_eq_true.mp h2 (f j) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨j, List.mem_range.mpr hj, rfl⟩)
  simpa using this

lemmas.name: mc38
lemmas.statement: ∀ (intervals : List (Prod Nat Nat)) (h : maxCoverageAfterRemovingOne_precond intervals), maxCoverageAfterRemovingOne_postcond intervals (((List.range intervals.length).map (fun (i : Nat) => let remaining := List.eraseIdx intervals i; let sorted := List.mergeSort remaining (fun (a b : Nat × Nat) => a.1 ≤ b.1); let merged := sorted.foldl (fun acc curr => match acc with | [] => [curr] | (s, e) :: rest => if curr.1 ≤ e then (s, max e curr.2) :: rest else curr :: acc) []; merged.reverse.foldl (fun acc (s, e) => acc + (e - s)) 0)).foldl max 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro intervals h
  unfold maxCoverageAfterRemovingOne_postcond
  obtain ⟨i, hi, he, hall⟩ := argmax_spec intervals.length (fun (i : Nat) => let remaining := List.eraseIdx intervals i; let sorted := List.mergeSort remaining (fun (a b : Nat × Nat) => a.1 ≤ b.1); let merged := sorted.foldl (fun acc curr => match acc with | [] => [curr] | (s, e) :: rest => if curr.1 ≤ e then (s, max e curr.2) :: rest else curr :: acc) []; merged.reverse.foldl (fun acc (s, e) => acc + (e - s)) 0) h
  exact ⟨i, hi, he.symm, fun j hj => le_of_le_of_eq (hall j hj) he.symm⟩
